events.title: Our Demo Is Finally Here! Launching October 19
events.summary: Hello everyone! 🐈🐈🐈 We're back!It's been a while since our last playtest. We've been heads-down working on a lot of changes, and we're finally ready to share some great news:The Paw and Plot Demo will launch at 8:00 PM Beijing Time on October 19! (13:00 London / 8:00 AM ET / 5:00 AM PT) it's a real Demo. If you missed the last test, you can jump right in this time!🐾🐾🐾 What's Changed Since the Test Version 🐾🐾🐾🗺️ All levels have been completely redesigned — every one is worth playing again 🎨 Updat

events.title: The Second playtest will be LIVE during Jun 26 to July 11
events.summary: Hello everyone! 🐈🐈🐈 We're back!Our second public playtest with save data wipe will begin on June 26! If you're interested in Paw and Plot, you'll be able to jump in and play this weekend!Compared to the previous test, we've made quite a few changes, including:🎨 Brand-new map visuals🕹️ Redesigned interaction systems📖 Reworked levels and tutorial👥 Added local and online PvP mode (you can now challenge your friends!)🐱 Cat accessories and skin system🐾🐾🐾 About the Game 🐾🐾🐾Paw and Plot is a lightheart

events.title: Paw and Plot beta play test start on Jan 30!
events.summary: Hello Gamers! 🐈🐈🐈 Welcome to this playtest!We'll launch the open beta test with data wipes on January 30th at 10 AM GMT Time! You can dive into our game this weekend!🐾🐾🐾About the Game🐾🐾🐾Paw Paw Strategy is a lighthearted and adorable hexagonal board turn-based strategy game. Players take on the role of Latte, a kitten separated from its family, who encounters the Cat Food God, Cantheon—a deity once protecting the local felines but now pursued by feral cat forces.
